citations: BDB 966 (root ś-ṭ-m); HALOT 1316; Hos 9:7-8 (maśṭēmâ rabbâ); CD 16:5; 1QS 3:18-25 (Two Spirits); 1QM 13:11; Test. Levi 19:1; VanderKam 2018 Hermeneia 1.852-865
glossaryReview.reasoning: Lexical evidence (root ś-ṭ-m via BDB+HALOT + Hos 9:7-8 noun attestation) is independently verifiable. Cross-corpus wiring to CD 16:5 + 1QS 3:23 (angel of darkness) + 1QM 13:11 (Belial-Mastema fusion) + Test. Levi 19 is correct. The 'foundational Second Temple Satan-figure development' claim is defensible — Jubilees + Qumran sectarian corpus represents the named-individuated-prince-of-evil-spirits development beyond HB ha-satan. claim_type=direct upheld.

citations: VanderKam 1989; VanderKam 2018 Hermeneia 1.51-58 (introduction); García Martínez 1997 'The Heavenly Tablets in the Book of Jubilees' in *Studies in the Book of Jubilees* pp. 243-260; Najman 1999 'Interpretation as Primordial Writing: Jubilees and Its Authority Conscious Strategy of Rewriting' *JSJ* 30:379-410
glossaryReview.reasoning: The 25+/30+ occurrences claim across Jubilees is correct (VanderKam 2018 Hermeneia introduction documents 30+ explicit references). García Martínez 1997 + Najman 1999 citations verified. The 'densest extant articulation' claim is defensible relative to 1 En 81 single-pericope. claim_type=direct upheld.

citations: VanderKam 1995 *Enoch: A Man for All Generations* (USC Press); VanderKam 2018 Hermeneia 1.451-490; Reed 2005 *Fallen Angels and the History of Judaism and Christianity* pp. 67-95; cf. 1 En 12-13 (Watchers scribal commission)
glossaryReview.reasoning: The 'EARLIEST EXTANT TEXT' claim for Enoch-as-first-human-scribe is defensible: 4Q216 dates to late 2nd c. BCE (Milik-VanderKam DJD XIII), making Jub 4:17 contemporaneous with 1 En 12-13 (Aramaic 4Q204+ likewise late 2nd c. BCE). The Jubilees text is the SYSTEMATIC-PRESENTATION (first-to-learn-writing + cosmic-knowledge + witness-against-Watchers + Eden-translation); 1 En 12-13 is the prior Watchers-scribal-material but does not have the FIRST-HUMAN-SCRIBE framing. The wording 'earliest extant SYSTEMATIC-PRESENTATION' would be more precise than 'EARLIEST EXTANT TEXT' simpliciter, but the claim is defensible. claim_type=direct upheld.

citations: García Martínez et al. DJD XXIII 1998 pp. 224-227 (11Q12 frag 8); VanderKam 2018 Hermeneia 1.501-540; Stuckenbruck 2014 *The Myth of Rebellious Angels*
glossaryReview.reasoning: Hebrew-primary at 5:1 via 11Q12 is well-attested. The 'compressed parallel to 1 En 6-11' framing is correct. claim_type=direct upheld.

citations: VanderKam 1989 + 2018 Hermeneia 1.950-980; Apoc. Abraham 1-8 (Rubinkiewicz 1983, OTP 1.681-705); b. Bava Batra 91a; Genesis Rabbah 38:13 (Theodor-Albeck ed.); Qur'an Sura 21:51-71, 37:83-98, 6:74-79, 19:41-50; Kugel 2012 *A Walk through Jubilees* pp. 75-85; van Ruiten 2012 *Abraham in the Book of Jubilees*
glossaryReview.reasoning: The 'EARLIEST EXTANT TEXT' claim is defensible: Jub 12 (late 2nd c. BCE) predates Apoc. Abraham (c. 70-150 CE), Genesis Rabbah (5th c.), b. Bava Batra (6th c.), and Qur'an (7th c.). The narrative elements (night-burning + Haran death in fire + Ur of Chaldees) are uniquely combined in Jub 12 before all later witnesses. Cross-corpus wiring to all four traditions is independently verifiable. claim_type=direct upheld.

citations: VanderKam 1998 *Calendars in the Dead Sea Scrolls*; Beckwith 1996 *Calendar and Chronology, Jewish and Christian*; Glessmer 1999 'Calendars in the Qumran Scrolls' in *Dead Sea Scrolls After Fifty Years* 2.213-78; VanderKam 2018 Hermeneia 1.605-625; CD 16:2-4
glossaryReview.reasoning: The 'FOUNDATIONAL polemical articulation' claim is defensible — Jub 6:32-38 is the explicit polemical-festal articulation of the 364-day system, while 1 En 72-82 is the technical-astronomical implementation. The two-tier framing (Jub = polemical foundation; 1 En = technical implementation) is the standard scholarly reading (VanderKam 1998; Beckwith 1996). claim_type=direct upheld.

The Mt-of-the-East identification is left ambiguous in the entry, deferring to apparatus — appropriate handling given van Ruiten 2000 + 1 En 24-25 alternative identifications. claim_type=direct upheld.

citations: Isa 63:9 (malak panav); Exod 23:20-23 + Exod 33:14-15 (the panim / malak); VanderKam 2018 Hermeneia 1.151-160; Orlov 2005 *The Enoch-Metatron Tradition*; Schaefer 2009 *The Origins of Jewish Mysticism*

paragraphs.text: ויהי בשנה הראשונה לצאת בני ישראל ממצרים בחדש השלישי בששה עשר יום לחדש ויאמר יהוה אל משה עלה אלי ההרה ואתנה לך את שני לחות האבן התורה והמצוה אשר כתבתי להורתם
paragraphs.translit: wa-yhī bə-šānāh hā-rīʾšōnāh lə-ṣēʾt bənē Yiśrāʾēl mi-Miṣrayim ba-ḥōdeš ha-šəlīšī bə-šiššāh ʿāśār yōm la-ḥōdeš wa-yōʾmer YHWH ʾel Mōšeh ʿălēh ʾēlay hā-hārāh wə-ʾettənāh lə-kā ʾet šənē luḥōt hā-ʾeben ha-tōrāh wə-ha-miṣwāh ʾăšer kātabtī lə-hōrōtām

i18n.en: And it came to pass in the first year of the going forth of the sons of Israel from Egypt, in the third month, on the sixteenth day of the month, that the Lord spoke to Moses, saying: Come up to me on the mountain, and I will give you the two tablets of stone — the law and the commandment — which I have written, that you may teach them.

paragraphs.commentary: The Sinai theophany frame: Moses ascends to receive the heavenly tablets. The Jubilees prologue grounds the entire book as a Sinai-revealed text dictated through the angel of the presence.

paragraphs.text: ויעל משה אל הר האלהים וישכן כבוד יהוה על הר סיני ויכסהו הענן ששת ימים
paragraphs.translit: wa-yaʿal Mōšeh ʾel har hā-ʾĕlōhīm wa-yiškōn kəbōd YHWH ʿal har Sīnay wa-yəkassēhū he-ʿānān šēšet yāmīm

i18n.en: And Moses went up to the mountain of God, and the glory of the Lord settled upon Mount Sinai, and the cloud covered it for six days.

paragraphs.text: ויקרא אל משה ביום השביעי מתוך הענן וירא את כבוד יהוה כאש אכלת בראש ההר
paragraphs.translit: wa-yiqrāʾ ʾel Mōšeh ba-yōm ha-šəbīʿī mi-tōk he-ʿānān wa-yarʾ ʾet kəbōd YHWH kə-ʾēš ʾōkelet bə-rōʾš hā-hār

i18n.en: And on the seventh day he called to Moses from the midst of the cloud, and Moses saw the glory of the Lord as a devouring fire on the top of the mountain.

paragraphs.text: ויהי משה בהר ארבעים יום וארבעים לילה ויראהו האלהים את אשר היה לפנים ואת אשר עתיד להיות בעולמים את חלקות העתים לתורה ולתעודה
paragraphs.translit: wa-yhī Mōšeh ba-hār ʾarbāʿīm yōm wə-ʾarbāʿīm laylāh wa-yarʾēhū hā-ʾĕlōhīm ʾet ʾăšer hāyāh lə-pānīm wə-ʾet ʾăšer ʿātīd li-hyōt bā-ʿōlāmīm ʾet ḥăluqqōt hā-ʿittīm la-tōrāh wə-la-təʿūdāh

i18n.en: And Moses was on the mountain forty days and forty nights, and God showed him what had been before and what was to come in the ages — the divisions of the times for the law and for the testimony.

paragraphs.text: ויאמר אליו תן לבך אל כל הדבר אשר אדבר אליך בהר הזה וכתב בספר למען ידעו דורותם כי לא עזבתים בכל הרעה אשר עשו לעבור את הברית אשר אני כורת היום ביני ובינך לזרעם בהר סיני
paragraphs.translit: wa-yōʾmer ʾēlāyw tēn libbə-kā ʾel kol ha-dābār ʾăšer ʾădabbēr ʾēlēkā ba-hār ha-zeh ū-ktōb ba-sēpher lə-maʿan yēdəʿū dōrōtām kī lōʾ ʿăzabtīm bə-kol hā-rāʿāh ʾăšer ʿāśū la-ʿăbōr ʾet ha-bərīt ʾăšer ʾănī kōrēt ha-yōm bēnī ū-bēnə-kā lə-zarʿām bə-har Sīnay

i18n.en: And he said to him: Set your heart upon every word that I shall speak to you on this mountain, and write them in a book, so that their generations may know that I have not forsaken them on account of all the evil they have done in transgressing the covenant that I am cutting today between me and you for their seed on Mount Sinai.

paragraphs.text: והיה כי תבאינה עליהם כל הרעות האלה ואמרו על כי לא היה אלהי עמדנו מצאוני הרעות האלה והם ישכחו כל מצותי אשר אני מצוה אותם וילכו אחרי הגוים ואחרי תועבותיהם ואחרי שקוציהם
paragraphs.translit: wə-hāyāh kī tābōʾnāh ʿălēhem kol hā-rāʿōt hā-ʾēlleh wə-ʾāmrū ʿal kī lōʾ hāyāh ʾĕlōhay ʿimmādēnū məṣāʾūnī hā-rāʿōt hā-ʾēlleh wə-hēm yiškəḥū kol miṣwōtay ʾăšer ʾănī məṣawweh ʾōtām wə-yēlkū ʾaḥărē ha-gōyīm wə-ʾaḥărē tōʿăbōtēhem wə-ʾaḥărē šiqqūṣēhem

i18n.en: And it shall be, when all these evils come upon them, they will say: Because our God was not among us, these evils have found us. And they shall forget all my commandments which I command them, and they shall walk after the nations and after their abominations and after their detestable things.

paragraphs.text: ועבדו את אלהי הגוים אשר היו לפח ולמכשול להם וטמאו את מקדשי ושכחו את החקים ואת המועדים ואת השבתות ואת הברית
paragraphs.translit: wə-ʿābdū ʾet ʾĕlōhē ha-gōyīm ʾăšer hāyū lə-paḥ ū-lə-mikšōl lā-hem wə-ṭimməʾū ʾet miqdāšī wə-šākəḥū ʾet ha-ḥuqqīm wə-ʾet ha-mōʿădīm wə-ʾet ha-šabbātōt wə-ʾet ha-bərīt

i18n.en: And they shall serve the gods of the nations, who shall be a snare and a stumbling-block to them; and they shall defile my sanctuary, and they shall forget the statutes and the appointed times and the sabbaths and the covenant.

paragraphs.text: ויהיו לי לעם וגם אני אהיה להם לאלהים ויאמרו כן אך אחרי כן ישובו אל אלהים נכר ואל זרים אשר לא יושיעום ואת הצדק יסבו
paragraphs.translit: wə-yihyū lī lə-ʿām wə-gam ʾănī ʾehyeh lā-hem lē-ʾlōhīm wə-yōʾmrū kēn ʾak ʾaḥărē kēn yāšūbū ʾel ʾĕlōhīm nēkār wə-ʾel zārīm ʾăšer lōʾ yōšīʿūm wə-ʾet ha-ṣedeq yāsōbbū

i18n.en: And they shall be a people to me, and I will be to them a God, and they will say: So be it. But afterwards they shall turn aside to foreign gods and to strangers who cannot save them, and they shall turn away from righteousness.

paragraphs.text: ועבדו את האבן ואת העץ ואת השמש ואת הירח ואת הכוכבים ואת כל צבא השמים והשדים ירשיעום עד היותם זרים ויטעו את עצמם בכל זנות וכל בני נכר ילדו להם
paragraphs.translit: wə-ʿābdū ʾet hā-ʾeben wə-ʾet hā-ʿēṣ wə-ʾet ha-šemeš wə-ʾet ha-yārēaḥ wə-ʾet ha-kōkābīm wə-ʾet kol ṣəbāʾ ha-šāmayim wə-ha-šēdīm yarśīʿūm ʿad heyōtām zārīm wə-yiṭʿū ʾet ʿaṣmām bə-kol zənūt wə-kol bənē nēkār yēlədū lā-hem

i18n.en: And they shall serve the stone and the wood and the sun and the moon and the stars and all the host of heaven, and the demons shall lead them astray until they become strangers; and they shall plant themselves in every fornication, and they shall bear all the children of foreigners.

paragraphs.text: ועברו את הברית אשר אני כורת עמהם והפכו את כל מצותי לחקת זרים ויעזבו את ביתי ואת מקדשי ואת השבת ואת הברית ויחללו את כל אלה
paragraphs.translit: wə-ʿābrū ʾet ha-bərīt ʾăšer ʾănī kōrēt ʿimmām wə-hāpəkū ʾet kol miṣwōtay lə-ḥuqqat zārīm wə-yaʿazbū ʾet bētī wə-ʾet miqdāšī wə-ʾet ha-šabbāt wə-ʾet ha-bərīt wī-ḥaləlū ʾet kol ʾēlleh

i18n.en: And they shall transgress the covenant which I cut with them, and they shall turn all my commandments into a statute of strangers, and they shall forsake my house and my sanctuary and the sabbath and the covenant, and they shall profane all these.

paragraphs.text: ויעשו להם במות ופסילים וצלמים ושחו לכל מעשה ידיהם ויזבחו את בניהם לשדים ולכל פעלי תועבת לבם
paragraphs.translit: wə-yaʿăśū lā-hem bāmōt ū-pəsīlīm ū-ṣəlāmīm wə-yištaḥăwū lə-kol maʿăśēh yədēhem wə-yizbəḥū ʾet bənēhem la-šēdīm ū-lə-kol pōʿălē tōʿăbat libbām

i18n.en: And they shall make for themselves high places and carved images and idols, and they shall bow down to every work of their hands; and they shall sacrifice their children to the demons and to every work of the abomination of their heart.

paragraphs.text: ושלחתי להם עדים להעידם ולא ישמעו וגם את הנביאים יהרגו וירדפו את החקרי תורה ואת הכל יסבו
paragraphs.translit: wə-šālaḥtī lā-hem ʿēdīm lə-hāʿīdām wə-lōʾ yišmāʿū wə-gam ʾet ha-nəbīʾīm yahargū wə-yirdəpū ʾet ha-ḥōqərē tōrāh wə-ʾet ha-kōl yāsōbbū

i18n.en: And I shall send to them witnesses to testify against them, but they will not hear; and the prophets also they shall kill, and they shall persecute those who search the law, and they shall turn aside from everything.

paragraphs.text: והסתרתי פני מהם ונתתים ביד הגוים לשבי ולבזה ולאכל וגרשתים מהארץ ופזרתים בגוים
paragraphs.translit: wə-histartī pānay mē-hem ū-nətattīm bə-yad ha-gōyīm la-šəbī wə-la-bizzāh wə-lā-ʾēkōl wə-gēraštīm mē-hā-ʾāreṣ ū-pizzartīm ba-gōyīm

i18n.en: And I shall hide my face from them, and shall give them into the hand of the nations for captivity and for plunder and for devouring; and I shall drive them out from the land and scatter them among the nations.

paragraphs.text: וישכחו את כל מצותי ואת כל אשר אני מצוה אותם וילכו אחרי חדשי הגוים ואחרי טמאתם ואחרי תועבותם ויסבו את שבתות הברית ואת חדשי ואת המועדים ואת היובלים ואת המשפטים
paragraphs.translit: wə-yiškəḥū ʾet kol miṣwōtay wə-ʾet kol ʾăšer ʾănī məṣawweh ʾōtām wə-yēlkū ʾaḥărē ḥodšē ha-gōyīm wə-ʾaḥărē ṭumʾātām wə-ʾaḥărē tōʿăbōtām wə-yāsōbbū ʾet šabbətōt ha-bərīt wə-ʾet ḥodšay wə-ʾet ha-mōʿădīm wə-ʾet ha-yōbəlīm wə-ʾet ha-mišpāṭīm

i18n.en: And they shall forget all my commandments and all that I command them, and they shall walk after the new moons of the nations and after their uncleanness and after their abominations; and they shall turn aside from the sabbaths of the covenant and from my new moons and from the appointed times and from the jubilees and from the judgments.

paragraphs.text: ואחרי כן ישובו אלי בכל לבבם ובכל נפשם ובכל מאדם ואשיב את שבותם מתוך הגוים ובקשוני וימצאוני בבקשם אותי בכל לבם ובכל נפשם
paragraphs.translit: wə-ʾaḥărē kēn yāšūbū ʾēlay bə-kol ləbābām ū-bə-kol napšām ū-bə-kol məʾōdām wa-ʾāšīb ʾet šəbūtām mi-tōk ha-gōyīm ū-biqšūnī ū-məṣāʾūnī bə-baqəšām ʾōtī bə-kol libbām ū-bə-kol napšām

i18n.en: And afterwards they shall return to me with all their heart and with all their soul and with all their might; and I shall bring back their captivity from among the nations, and they shall seek me, and they shall find me when they seek me with all their heart and with all their soul.

paragraphs.text: ואהפכם לצמח צדק והיו לי לברכה ולא לקללה והיו לראש ולא לזנב
paragraphs.translit: wa-ʾahapkēm lə-ṣemaḥ ṣedeq wə-hāyū lī li-brākāh wə-lōʾ li-qəlālāh wə-hāyū lə-rōʾš wə-lōʾ lə-zānāb

i18n.en: And I shall transform them into a plant of righteousness, and they shall be for me a blessing and not a curse; and they shall be the head and not the tail.

paragraphs.text: ወእነድቅ፡ መቅደስየ፡ ማእከሎሙ፡ ወእኀድር፡ ምስሌሆሙ፡ ወእከውኖሙ፡ አምላከ፡ ወእሙንቱ፡ ይከውኑኒ፡ ሕዝበ፡ በአማን፡ ወበጽድቅ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-ʾənadəq maqdasəya māʾkalomu wa-ʾəḫaddər məslēhomu wa-ʾəkawwənomu ʾamlāka wa-ʾəmuntu yəkawwənuni ḥəzba ba-ʾamān wa-ba-ṣədq

i18n.en: And I shall build my sanctuary in their midst and dwell with them; and I shall be their God, and they shall be my people in truth and in righteousness.

paragraphs.text: ወኢየኀድጎሙ፡ ወኢይከውኖሙ፡ ጸላዕተ፡ እስመ፡ አነ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ አምላኮሙ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-ʾi-yəḫaddəgomu wa-ʾi-yəkawwənomu ṣalāʾta ʾəsma ʾana ʾəgziʾabəḥēr ʾamlākomu

i18n.en: And I shall not forsake them nor be hostile to them, for I am the Lord their God.

paragraphs.text: ወወድቀ፡ ሙሴ፡ በገጹ፡ ወጸለየ፡ ወይቤ፡ እግዚእየ፡ አምላኪየ፡ ኢተኀድግ፡ ሕዝበከ፡ ወርስተከ፡ ይሑሩ፡ በስሕተተ፡ ልቦሙ፡ ወኢተአግቦሙ፡ ውስተ፡ እደ፡ አሕዛብ፡ ከመ፡ ይኩንዎሙ፡ ለፂዋዌ፡ ወኢከመ፡ ይትገበር፡ ላዕሌሆሙ፡ ኵሉ፡ መርገም፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-wadqa Mussē ba-gaṣṣu wa-ṣallaya wa-yəbē ʾəgziʾəya ʾamlākiya ʾi-tāḫaddəg ḥəzbaka wa-rəstaka yəḥuru ba-səḥtata ləbomu wa-ʾi-taʾgəbomu wəsta ʾəda ʾaḥzāb kama yəkunwomu la-ḍəwāwē wa-ʾi-kama yətgabbar lāʿlēhomu kwəlu margam

i18n.en: And Moses fell on his face and prayed and said: My Lord, my God, do not forsake your people and your inheritance, that they should walk in the error of their heart; and do not deliver them into the hand of the nations, that they should rule over them for captivity, nor that every curse should be done upon them.

paragraphs.text: እግዚእየ፡ ይትኬሰት፡ ምሕረትከ፡ ላዕለ፡ ሕዝብከ፡ ወፍጠር፡ ሎሙ፡ መንፈሰ፡ ርቱዐ፡ ወኢይኩንዎሙ፡ መንፈሰ፡ ቤልሐራ፡ ከመ፡ ይውስኖሙ፡ እምቅድመ፡ ገጽከ፡ እስከ፡ ለዓለም፡
paragraphs.translit: ʾəgziʾəya yətkēsat məḥrataka lāʿla ḥəzbəka wa-fəṭər lomu manfasa rətuʿa wa-ʾi-yəkunwomu manfasa Bēlhārā kama yəwsənomu ʾəm-qədma gaṣṣəka ʾəska la-ʿālam

i18n.en: My Lord, let your mercy be poured out upon your people, and create in them an upright spirit; and let not the spirit of Beliar rule over them, to accuse them before your face for ever.

paragraphs.text: ወከሠተ፡ ቃሎ፡ እግዚእ፡ ለሙሴ፡ ወይቤሎ፡ ዘስሕተተ፡ ልቦሙ፡ ኣአምር፡ አንሰ፡ ወድፍረተ፡ ክሳዶሙ፡ ወኢይትኤዘዙኒ፡ እስከ፡ ይትዐመቁ፡ ኀጢአቶሙ፡ ወይትዐቆቡ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-kaśata qālo ʾəgziʾ la-Mussē wa-yəbēlo za-səḥtata ləbomu ʾaʾammər ʾanasa wa-dəfrata kəsādomu wa-ʾi-yətʾəzazunī ʾəska yətʿamməqu ḫāṭiʾatomu wa-yətʿaqqabu

i18n.en: And the Lord opened his word to Moses and said to him: I know the error of their heart, and the stiffness of their neck; they will not be obedient to me, until they acknowledge the depth of their sin and are aware of it.

paragraphs.text: ወእምድኅረ፡ ዝንቱ፡ ይትመየጡ፡ ኀቤየ፡ በኵሉ፡ ጽድቅ፡ ወበኵሉ፡ ልብ፡ ወበኵሉ፡ ነፍስ፡ ወእመትር፡ ቍልፈ፡ ልቦሙ፡ ወቍልፈ፡ ልበ፡ ዘርዖሙ፡ ወእፈጥር፡ ሎሙ፡ መንፈሰ፡ ቅዱሰ፡ ወእነጽሖሙ፡ ከመ፡ ኢይትገሐሡ፡ እምነየ፡ እምይእቲ፡ ዕለት፡ ወእስከ፡ ለዓለም፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-ʾəmdəḫra zəntu yətmayyəṭu ḫabēya ba-kwəlu ṣədq wa-ba-kwəlu ləb wa-ba-kwəlu nafs wa-ʾəmattər qwəlfa ləbomu wa-qwəlfa ləba zarʿomu wa-ʾəfaṭṭər lomu manfasa qəddusa wa-ʾənaṣṣəḥomu kama ʾi-yətgaḥaśu ʾəmnēya ʾəm-yəʾəti ʿəlat wa-ʾəska la-ʿālam

i18n.en: And after this they shall turn to me in all righteousness and with all their heart and with all their soul; and I shall circumcise the foreskin of their heart and the foreskin of the heart of their seed, and I shall create in them a holy spirit and shall cleanse them, that they may not turn from me from that day and for ever.

paragraphs.text: ወይትለአኩኒ፡ ኵሎሙ፡ ወይከውኑኒ፡ አበ፡ ወአንሰ፡ እከውኖሙ፡ ወልደ፡ ወይሰመዩ፡ ኵሎሙ፡ ደቂቀ፡ አምላክ፡ ሕያው፡ ወያአምርዎሙ፡ ኵሉ፡ መልአክ፡ ወኵሉ፡ መንፈስ፡ ወያአምሩ፡ ከመ፡ እሙንቱ፡ ውሉድየ፡ ወአንሰ፡ አቡሆሙ፡ በርትዕ፡ ወበጽድቅ፡ ወእመፍቅሮሙ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-yətlaʾakkunī kwəlomu wa-yəkawwənuni ʾabba wa-ʾanasa ʾəkawwənomu walda wa-yəsammayu kwəlomu daqiqa ʾamlāk ḥəyāw wa-yāʾəmərwomu kwəlu malʾak wa-kwəlu manfas wa-yāʾəməru kama ʾəmuntu wəludəya wa-ʾanasa ʾabuhomu ba-rətʿ wa-ba-ṣədq wa-ʾəmafqəromu

i18n.en: And they shall all serve me, and they shall be to me a father, and I shall be to them a son; and they shall all be called children of the living God. And every angel and every spirit shall know them and know that they are my children and that I am their father in uprightness and in righteousness, and that I love them.

paragraphs.text: ወአንሰ፡ እነግረከ፡ ግዕዘ፡ ኵሉ፡ ወይከውን፡ ኵሉ፡ ቃልየ፡ ጽድቀ፡ ላዕሌሆሙ፡ ወኢይትዐደው፡ ሥርዐትየ፡ ወኢይትዐደው፡ ቃልየ፡ ኵሉ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-ʾanasa ʾənaggərkka gəʿza kwəlu wa-yəkawwən kwəlu qāləya ṣədqa lāʿlēhomu wa-ʾi-yətʿaddaw śərʿatəya wa-ʾi-yətʿaddaw qāləya kwəlu

i18n.en: And I shall tell you the nature of everything, and all my word shall be truth concerning them; and they shall not transgress my ordinance, nor shall they transgress any of my word.

paragraphs.text: ወአንተ፡ ጸሐፍ፡ ሎሙ፡ ኵሎ፡ ቃላተ፡ ዘእነግረከ፡ በዝ፡ ደብር፡ ቀዳማውያተ፡ ወደኃራውያተ፡ ወዘይከውን፡ በኵሉ፡ ክፍለ፡ መዋዕል፡ በሕግ፡ ወበስምዕ፡ ወበሰናብት፡ ወበኢዮቤልዎናት፡ እስከ፡ ለዓለም፡ እስከ፡ ይትገበር፡ መቅደስ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ በማእከሎሙ፡ ቅዱስ፡ ለኵሉ፡ ዓለማት፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-ʾanta ṣaḥaf lomu kwəlo qālāta zaʾənaggərkka ba-zə dabr qadāmāwiyāta wa-daḫārāwiyāta wa-zayəkawwən ba-kwəlu kəfla mawāʿəl ba-ḥəg wa-ba-səmʿ wa-ba-sanābt wa-ba-ʾiyobēləwānāt ʾəska la-ʿālam ʾəska yətgabbar maqdas ʾəgziʾabəḥēr ba-māʾkalomu qəddus la-kwəlu ʿālamāt

i18n.en: And you, write for them all the words that I shall tell you on this mountain — the first things and the last, and what shall come to pass in every division of the times, in the law and in the testimony, and in the weeks and in the jubilees, for ever, until the sanctuary of the Lord is built in their midst, holy for all ages.

paragraphs.text: ויאמר אל מלאך הפנים כתב למשה מראש בריאה עד הבנות מקדשי בתוכם לעולם ועד
paragraphs.translit: wa-yōʾmer ʾel malʾak ha-pānīm kətōb lə-Mōšeh mē-rōʾš bərīʾāh ʿad hēbānōt miqdāšī bə-tōkām lə-ʿōlām wā-ʿed

i18n.en: And he said to the angel of the presence: Write for Moses from the beginning of creation until my sanctuary is built in their midst for ever and ever.

paragraphs.commentary: The heavenly tablets motif introduced: the entire content of Jubilees is presented as inscribed on the heavenly tablets, granting it pre-Mosaic authority. Foundational predestinarian apocalyptic-canon-of-history.

paragraphs.text: ויקח מלאך הפנים את לוחות חלקות העתים מהשמים מן הברית הראשונה ויתן אותם למשה
paragraphs.translit: wa-yiqqaḥ malʾak ha-pānīm ʾet lūḥōt ḥăluqqōt hā-ʿittīm mē-ha-šāmayim min ha-bərīt hā-rīʾšōnāh wa-yittēn ʾōtām lə-Mōšeh

i18n.en: And the angel of the presence took the tablets of the divisions of the times from the heavens, from the first covenant, and gave them to Moses.

paragraphs.commentary: Introduction of the angel of the presence (malak ha-panim) as the chief celestial mediator + dictator of Jubilees to Moses. Cross-corpus to Isa 63:9 + Hekhalot Sar ha-Panim / Metatron tradition.

paragraphs.text: ወይትዐየን፡ እግዚእ፡ በቅድመ፡ ኵሉ፡ ወይትአመር፡ ኵሉ፡ ከመ፡ አንሰ፡ አምላከ፡ እስራኤል፡ ወአቡ፡ ለኵሉ፡ ደቂቀ፡ ያዕቆብ፡ ወንጉሥ፡ በደብረ፡ ጽዮን፡ ለዓለመ፡ ዓለም፡ ወጽዮን፡ ወኢየሩሳሌም፡ ይኩና፡ ቅዱሳተ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-yətʿayyan ʾəgziʾ ba-qədma kwəlu wa-yətʾammar kwəlu kama ʾanasa ʾamlāka ʾəsrāʾēl wa-ʾabu la-kwəlu daqiqa Yāʿqob wa-nəguśə ba-dabra Ṣəyon la-ʿālama ʿālam wa-Ṣəyon wa-ʾIyarusālēm yəkunā qəddusāta

i18n.en: And the Lord shall appear before the eyes of all, and all shall know that I am the God of Israel and the father of all the sons of Jacob and king upon Mount Zion for ever and ever; and Zion and Jerusalem shall be holy.

paragraphs.text: ויקח מלאך הפנים שהיה הולך לפני מחנה ישראל את לוחות חלקות שני וחדשי וחגי וביובלי וחגי שנות העולם לישראל לכל דורות עולם מן יום הבריאה עד היום שיתחדשו השמים והארץ וכל יצירתם ככחות השמים וככל יצירת הארץ עד הברא מקדש האדון בירושלים בהר ציון וכל המאורות מתחדשים לרפא ולשלום ולברכה לכל בחירי ישראל ולמען כן יהיה כן מאותו היום והלאה כל ימי הארץ
paragraphs.translit: wa-yiqqaḥ malʾak ha-pānīm še-hāyāh hōlēk li-pnē maḥănēh Yiśrāʾēl ʾet lūḥōt ḥăluqqōt šənē wə-ḥodšē wə-ḥaggē wə-bə-yōbəlē wə-ḥaggē šənōt hā-ʿōlām lə-Yiśrāʾēl lə-kol dōrōt ʿōlām min yōm ha-bərīʾāh ʿad ha-yōm še-yitḥaddəšū ha-šāmayim wə-hā-ʾāreṣ wə-kol yəṣīrātām kə-kōḥōt ha-šāmayim ū-kə-kol yəṣīrat hā-ʾāreṣ ʿad hēbārēʾ miqdaš hā-ʾādōn bī-rūšālayim bə-har Ṣiyyōn wə-kol ha-məʾōrōt mit-ḥaddəšīm lə-rāpōʾ wə-lə-šālōm wə-li-brākāh lə-kol bəḥīrē Yiśrāʾēl ū-lə-maʿan kēn yihyeh kēn mē-ʾōtō ha-yōm wā-hālʾāh kol yəmē hā-ʾāreṣ

i18n.en: And the angel of the presence — who was going before the camp of Israel — took the tablets of the divisions of the years and of the months and of the feasts and of the jubilees and of the feasts of the years of the world, for Israel and for all the generations of the world, from the day of creation until the day when the heavens and the earth and all their creatures shall be renewed according to the powers of heaven and according to all the creation of the earth — until the sanctuary of the Lord is built in Jerusalem on Mount Zion, and all the luminaries are renewed for healing and for peace and for blessing for all the elect of Israel, and that so it may be from that day and onward all the days of the earth.
